status: round completed with reproducible full-model prefill gains; hardware performance ceiling and decode optimization remain open

accepted.entry: --prefill chunk4; explicit opt-in, BF16 and both W8A16 weight modes
accepted.architecture: Layer-major four-token activation slots, stage-contiguous paired attention and FP32 WKV, four-token FFN. FFN has 4 key, 4 collect/activation, 4 value and 3 norm/mix/residual workers. Value activation blocks are read from device-written DDR after an explicit device DMA completion boundary.
accepted.reuse: One FFN weight stream serves four tokens; BF16 67108864 bytes/chunk, INT8 34078720 bytes/chunk. Value activation rereads 2097152 bytes/chunk. These are scheduled payloads, not bandwidth counters.
accepted.state_and_precision: Original per-token MAC/reduction order, FP32 WKV/shift/state, original double statistics and special math. INT8 remains W8A16 BF16 MAC with FP32 accumulation, not native INT8 MAC. No activation quantization, fast-math or CPU/GPU arithmetic fallback.
accepted.buffers: Additional 60977152 bytes vs batch2; CPU embedding/sampling boundary unchanged. No host activation round trip.
accepted.contexts: Output-stride PDI bytes are checked before xclbin/context sharing. Existing runtime unchanged.

performance.conclusion: Prefill improved approximately 29-34%. No stable decode improvement established. Initial BF16 short-run ~1% decode slowdown was not reproduced by the longer counterbalanced run.
performance.method: Full 24-layer model, fixed synthetic tokens, serial NPU, A/B/B/A for 32 tokens and B/A/A/B for 128-token BF16. Two trials/process; all samples retained. Stage/profile/trace timings excluded.

validation.per_precision: 2628 fresh-build chunk4 bitwise snapshot vectors plus full zero-state chunk check; 1533 original batch2 vectors; 1116 original decode vectors across 128 steps. All three modes pass.
validation.stage: BF16/W8A16 FP64 oracles, bitwise intermediate/output/shift checks, guards, reset/branch and immutable inputs pass.
validation.artifact_rebuild: Full offline compiler succeeds; fresh-root C++ dispatch and snapshots pass. Extracted PDI audited separately from container UUID/metadata.

restoration.final_device: Production FFN oracle/shift/replay/guards passed after both trace rounds; no hardware contexts running at end

rejected.paired_local_weight_loads: BF16 full-model mean prefill change only ~0.02%; INT8 stage screen slower. Candidate reverted, production never overwritten; rwkv7-ffn-pair-load-rejected-2026-10-03.json.
rejected.prior_unfinished_worker_experiments: Audited existing eight-worker DMA/fan-in failures and historical device-recovery logs. No unchanged retry or claim of success; recorded in rebaseline report.

remaining_and_next: Decode ms/token has not materially improved in this round. Investigate BF16 weight-FIFO supply/routing using the fresh trace before increasing workers; account for MemTile fan-in/local storage and previously failed layouts.

For larger chunks, redesign bounded activation storage and producer/consumer overlap; do not assume a large CLI chunk equals an on-chip matrix dimension. Current chunk4 recurrence still uses paired FP32 updates.

Current chunk4 instrumented recurrence is approximately 28.5 ms/token and FFN approximately 22.1 BF16 / 24.6-24.7 W8A16 ms/token. These host stage times include switching/DMA/waits and are not pure compute.
Keep FP64-to-FP32, approximate math, reduction reordering and activation quantization separate numerical experiments with predeclared thresholds. None adopted here.

Chunk4 bitwise prompt coverage reaches 64 tokens; performance coverage reaches 128. No 25600-context quality validation or architecture roofline proof. Small prompts with 1-3-token tails may have different tradeoffs.

reproduce.benchmark: ./build/release/rwkv-bench "$MODEL" build/kernels/chunk4 32 24 2 --prefill-chunk4 [--int8-ffn|--int8-ffn-output]; compare --prefill-batch2 in A/B/B/A order. Use 128 96 2 and B/A/A/B for longer BF16.
